output.summary: A fast-growing annual plant native to North America. Its spreading stems form ground-hugging mats, and its small hairy leaves usually bear a central brown spot. Broken leaves or stems release poisonous milky sap that can irritate skin and cause stomach irritation and vomiting if swallowed.
output.edibilityNote: The poisonous milky sap has been ingested medicinally as a laxative or to induce vomiting, but can irritate the stomach and cause vomiting.
